en: It's quiz time at the Radio Tower! Answer five questions right and win a Radio Card for your Pokégear. Ready?
Question one! Can a Pokémon learn new moves as it levels up?
Question two! Is Chikorita a Grass-type Pokémon?
Question three! Will an Antidote wake a Pokémon that is fast asleep?
Question four! Do Fire-type moves hit Grass-type Pokémon especially hard?
Last question! Can you throw a Poké Ball to catch another trainer's Pokémon?
Five out of five! Congratulations! Here's your prize: a Radio Card for your Pokégear!
{player}'s Pokégear can now tune in to the radio!
Turn the dial to find our stations. We broadcast all over Johto, day and night!
Oh, I'm sorry! That's not right. Have another go any time you like.
No? Come back when you're feeling clever!
Enjoying the radio? Try every station on the dial. There's always something on!
